exposure: caesarean delivery with temporary bilateral internal iliac artery occlusion
cohort: This study included 29 pregnant women with placenta accreta spectrum, with 15 women undergoing caesarean delivery with temporary bilateral internal iliac artery occlusion and 14 women receiving standard caesarean delivery.
finding: Caesarean delivery for placenta accreta spectrum with bilateral balloon occlusion of the internal iliac arteries was associated with a lower need for blood transfusions and a decreased complication rate compared to standard caesarean delivery.
